messages:
morgan_fin: Heads-up — just reconciled March invoice and found an odd pair of lines for us-central1 GPUs. There's a +8,120 TieredUsageCharge and a separate -8,120 ReclassificationCorrection. On-paper they net to zero but our ETL picked up the charge twice because one row was scoped to billingAccount and one to project.

morgan_fin: Raw excerpt from the CSV:
```
InvoiceLineItemId,SKU,Description,Amount,BillingAccount,ProjectId
IL-987654,SKU:TIERED_GPU,Original usage charge,8120.00,BA-9999,projects/ml-prod
IL-987655,SKU:RECLASS_CORR,Reclassification correction,-8120.00,BA-9999,
```

tim_ops: ugh. if the ETL normalizer doesn't prefer the correction row when project_id is null it might keep the positive project-scoped line. that's how we end up counting it twice in monthly rollups.

rika_billing: opened CASE-2026-3321 with cloud billing. description: "TieredUsageCharge + ReclassificationCorrection both emitted; ETL double-counting original charge." billing-bot: created CASE-2026-3321 (ETA 72h).

nate_sre: quick BigQuery check to find similar patterns:
```
SELECT invoice_id, sku, description, amount, billing_account_id, project_id
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp.billing_export`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-03' AND sku IN ('SKU:TIERED_GPU','SKU:RECLASS_CORR')
ORDER BY invoice_id, amount DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Look for matching abs(amount) pairs where one row has project_id IS NULL and the other has project_id NOT NULL.

morgan_fin: ran the query and found 6 invoice pairs like this across Mar for different regions. Net invoice impact is zero, but our spend pipeline currently records the positive line when project_id exists and ignores the null-scoped correction, so reported spend is overstated by ~24.3k for March.

tim_ops: operational impact: forecast model will think we used more on-demand/accelerator minutes than actually billed. For reserved planning that could push us to overcommit next quarter.

rika_billing: action list I'm adding to the billing ticket and internal checklist:
- Flag the project-scoped positive lines as "suspect" when a same-amount opposite-signed org-scoped line exists.
- Patch ETL to prefer the org-scoped correction row when present, or to dedupe by invoice_id+abs(amount)+region.
- Notify finance forecast owners to backfill corrected March numbers.

billing-bot: CASE-2026-3321 updated by rika_billing: "Attached CSV with 6 matched pairs, requesting explanation and correction method."

nate_sre: I'll add a unit test to cost-ingest that simulates paired reclassification rows and asserts de-duplication. Also adding alert to monthly-billing-checks: if sum(abs(reclassification corrections)) > $5k for a region, fail the job and require manual review.

morgan_fin: thanks. I'll update the Q2 reserved-capacity notes and reduce suggested additional GPU purchase by the overstated amount until support confirms a fix or issues a corrected invoice. Will post updates from CASE-2026-3321 here. :spiral_calendar:
